_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Diver's Safety Check List
summary: Specifies the format and content requirements for a Diver's Safety Check List used to ensure proper alignment of ship systems and alert personnel to ongoing diving operations.
use_relationship:
The Diver's Safety Check List will be used to ensure the proper alignment of ship systems and to alert personnel to the on-going conduct of diving operations.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and preparation instructions for the data product specified in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Diver's Safety Check List shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Diver's Safety Check List shall include:

children.title: Name of ship undergoing hull cleaning.
Text of word to passed over the ship's 1MC prior to commencement of diving operation and every thirty (30) minutes thereafter during diving operation.
List of equipment tagged out for the operation
List of equipment remaining in operation.
List and location of any hull patches and cofferdams installed.
Signatures and dates of signature of Engineering Duty Officer/Command Duty Officer/Officer of the Deck/Diving Supervisor.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirements
preparation_instructions.content: The Diver's Safety Check List shall be in Adobe Acrobat (PDF).
